 NOTICE AND CALL OF SPECIAL MEETING OF THE INGLEWOOD CITY COUNCIL (Government Code Section
  54956)

  TO THE MEMBERS OF THE INGLEWOOD CITY COUNCIL

NOTICE IS HEREBY ORDERED by the Mayor that a special meeting of the City Council will be held on Friday,
July 30, 2021, at 8:30 a.m., in the Council Chambers, One Manchester Boulevard, Inglewood, California
(Government Code Section 54956)

*****NOTE FROM THE CITY: PUBLIC PARTICIPATION: Due to the existing COVID -19 health emergency and
the social distancing measures currently in effect, and pursuant to the Governor’s Executive Order N-29-20
(https://www.gov.ca.gov/wp -content/uploads/2020/03/3.17.20-N-29-20-EO.pdf).

Special Meeting of July 30, 2021, at 8:30 A.M. for open session as follows:

Inglewood, California
  July 30, 2021

  The City Council of the City of Inglewood, California held a special meeting on Friday,
  July 30, 2021, in the Council Chambers in City Hall of said City.
  Following the Pledge of Allegiance to the flag of our Country, Mayor Butts called the
  City Council into session at the hour of 8:30 a.m.
  The City Clerk announced the presence of a quorum as follows:

  Present:  Council Members Dotson, Morales, Faulk, and Mayor
  Butts; and
  Absent:  Council Member Padilla.
  City officials and personnel present were as follows:
  Aisha L. Thompson  City Clerk
  Artie Fields  City Manager
  Ken Campos  City Attorney
  David Esparza  Assistant City Manager
  Angela Allen  Deputy City Clerk

  PUBLIC COMMENTS. Mayor Butts inquired if there were any persons present who
  wished to address the City Council on this matter.

  There was no response.

178  AGREEMENT NO. 21-207 APPROVED – COUNTY OF LOS ANGELES;
  RESOLUTION NO. 21-124 ADOPTED - AMENDING THE FISCAL YEAR 2020-
  2021 BUDGET. Staff report dated July 30, 2021, was presented recommending
  approval of a one-year Agreement with the County of Los Angeles in an amount not to
  exceed $5,000,000, authorizing the Chief of Police (or designee) to request supplemental
  law enforcement services for professional sporting and entertainment events from the Los
  Angeles County Sheriff’s Department (LASD).

  It was moved by Council Member Morales, and seconded by Council Member Faulk that
  the City Council does hereby: 1) Approve Agreement No. 21-207; and 2) Adopt
  Resolution No. 21-124 entitled:

  A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  INGLEWOOD, CALIFRONIA, AMENDING THE FISCAL YEAR
  2020-2021 BUDGET TO INCLUDE FUNDS IN THE AMOUNT OF
  $5,000,000

  The motion was carried by the following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Council Members Dotson, Morales, Faulk, and Mayor Butts;
  Noes: None; and
  Absent: Council Member Padilla.

  There being no further business to be presented, Mayor Butts declared the meeting
  adjourned at the hour of 8:32 a.m.

  Approved this 12th day of October, 2021.

  _________________________
  Aisha L. Thompson, City Clerk

  ____________________________
 James Butts, Jr., Mayor
